claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Quipazine is a serotonin receptor agonist that is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any observed antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect non-specific cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or weak off-target activity rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
